title: Plenum - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Plenum in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Plenum is a ice-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Defense (C), Luck (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Plenum
sections.content:
Location: Yellow Harvest - defeat Glaise.

Obtained from Yellow Harvest - defeat Glaise.

sections.title: Is the Plenum Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (C), Luck (B). A dedicated ice pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
